title: Local etale representatives around a closed subscheme
statement: Let i:Z→X be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion]. For a sheaf of sets F on X_et [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] and a section t of i_et^*F at the base change of the identity X-object [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures], there are a universe-u index type J, etale X-objects U_j and sections s_j in F(U_j) such that the union of the images of U_j contains i(Z), and i^*s_j equals the restriction of t to U_j times_X Z. No compactness or injectivity hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 09ZF, lemma-gabber-h0, fourth proof paragraph through surjectivity of the union of local representing etale schemes

proof.text: Identify the base change of the identity X-object with the identity Z-object using the unique isomorphism between terminal objects. Transport t along this isomorphism and use the existing local inverse-image section description to obtain an etale cover V_j of Z, X-objects U_j, maps a_j and representing sections s_j.

proof.text: The cover map followed by the identity-object comparison equals the unique map into the base-changed terminal object. Naturality of restriction rewrites the local equation into the hypothesis of the single-representative shrinking lemma. Apply that lemma to every representative.

source.place: Tag 09ZF, lemma-gabber-h0, fourth proof paragraph through surjectivity of the union of local representing etale schemes

proof.text: Choose the resulting U_j and s_j. Every z in Z lies in the image of a cover member V_j, and the shrinking lemma places its image i(z) in U_j. Thus their union contains i(Z); the unit equations are those provided by the shrinking lemma.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_closed_section_local_family
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (t : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))))) :
    ∃ (J : Type u) (U : J → X.Etale) (s : ∀ j, F.obj.obj (op (U j))),
      Set.range i ⊆ ⋃ j, Set.range (U j).hom ∧
      ∀ j, etaleSetDescentUnit i F (U j) (s j) =
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.map
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).map
            (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (U j).hom (Category.comp_id _) :
              U j ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))).op t
